profile.summary: Telos Academy is a therapeutic boarding school in Orem, Utah for teenage boys ages 14 to 17. It combines accredited high school classes with residential mental health treatment and mentoring for students dealing with depression, anxiety, learning differences and emotional challenges. It is part of the Telos organization, which also offers outpatient programs.
